text.tspan: Annual death rate from all natural disastersWorld, 2000 to 2025
Death rates are measured as the number of deaths per 100,000 people. Disasters include events such as
earthquakes, volcanoes, droughts, wildfires, storms, and floods.
Data source: EM-DAT, CRED / UCLouvain (2026); Population based on various sources (2024)
Note: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
